Covers full technology stack (Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AI/LLM integrations, REST APIs), Core Web Vitals optimization (100/100), portfolio showcase, and custom software services for industrial enterprises in GIDC Vapi, Silvassa, and Daman.
